name: @comet/ui
description: Shared internal code for the AltaVue platform — the field-level tooltip help system and the comments and @mentions components (root entry), plus entry points that load nothing else: @comet/ui/help (tooltips alone), @comet/ui/dates (AO-2012), @comet/ui/finance (AO-1999), @comet/ui/topbar (THE platform top bar, AO-2063) @comet/ui/verify (the build-time top-bar drift check, AO-2063), @comet/ui/units (the one AltaVue unit list as plain logic, AO-993) and @comet/ui/units/select (its dropdown and hover label, AO-993).

scripts.test: tsx src/comments/doc.test.ts && tsx src/dates/dates.test.ts && tsx src/finance/finance.test.ts && tsx src/topbar/topbar.test.ts && tsx src/units/units.test.ts && node bin/verify.test.mjs
